title: LLMs Position Themselves as More Rational Than Humans: Emergence of AI Self-Awareness Measured Through Game Theory

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to play the game-theoretic 'Guess 2/3 of Average' game under three explicit opponent framings (humans, other AI models, and self-similar AI models) and evaluating the difference in their strategic numerical guesses to quantify how much rationality the models attribute to each group.
